properties.name: persistence

properties.name: tenant
properties.description: The tenant

properties.name: namespace
properties.description: The namespace

properties.name: topic
properties.description: The topic

properties.name: authenticationClass
properties.label: common
properties.description: The Authentication FQCN to be used while creating the client from URI

properties.name: authenticationParams
properties.label: common
properties.description: The Authentication Parameters to be used while creating the client from URI

properties.name: serviceUrl
properties.label: common
properties.description: The Pulsar Service URL to point while creating the client from URI

properties.name: ackGroupTimeMillis
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Group the consumer acknowledgments for the specified time in milliseconds - defaults to 100

properties.name: ackTimeoutMillis
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Timeout for unacknowledged messages in milliseconds - defaults to 10000

properties.name: ackTimeoutRedeliveryBackoff
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: RedeliveryBackoff to use for ack timeout redelivery backoff.

properties.name: allowManualAcknowledgement
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Whether to allow manual message acknowledgements. If this option is enabled, then messages are not acknowledged automatically after successful route completion. Instead, an instance of PulsarMessageReceipt is stored as a header on the org.apache.camel.Exchange. Messages can then be acknowledged using PulsarMessageReceipt at any time before the ackTimeout occurs.

properties.name: consumerName
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Name of the consumer when subscription is EXCLUSIVE

properties.name: consumerNamePrefix
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Prefix to add to consumer names when a SHARED or FAILOVER subscription is used

properties.name: consumerQueueSize
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Size of the consumer queue - defaults to 10

properties.name: deadLetterTopic
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Name of the topic where the messages which fail maxRedeliverCount times will be sent. Note: if not set, default topic name will be topicName-subscriptionName-DLQ

properties.name: enableBatchIndexAcknowledgment
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: When enabled, allows each individual message in a batch to be acknowledged independently. By default Pulsar redelivers the entire batch when any single message in the batch is not acknowledged. This option also requires the Pulsar broker to be configured with acknowledgmentAtBatchIndexLevelEnabled=true.

properties.name: enableRetry
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: To enable retry letter topic mode. The default retry letter topic uses this format: topicname-subscriptionname-RETRY

properties.name: keySharedPolicy
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Policy to use by consumer when using key-shared subscription type.

properties.name: maxRedeliverCount
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Maximum number of times that a message will be redelivered before being sent to the dead letter queue. If this value is not set, no Dead Letter Policy will be created

properties.name: messageListener
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Whether to use the messageListener interface, or to receive messages using a separate thread pool

properties.name: negativeAckRedeliveryBackoff
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: RedeliveryBackoff to use for negative ack redelivery backoff.

properties.name: negativeAckRedeliveryDelayMicros
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Set the negative acknowledgement delay

properties.name: numberOfConsumers
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Number of consumers - defaults to 1

properties.name: numberOfConsumerThreads
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Number of threads to receive and handle messages when using a separate thread pool

properties.name: readCompacted
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Enable compacted topic reading.

properties.name: retryLetterTopic
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Name of the topic to use in retry mode. Note: if not set, default topic name will be topicName-subscriptionName-RETRY

properties.name: subscriptionInitialPosition
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Control the initial position in the topic of a newly created subscription. Default is latest message.

properties.name: subscriptionMode
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Determines the subscription mode for the consumer. Durable subscriptions persist the cursor position if the consumer disconnects while non-durable subscriptions do not.

properties.name: subscriptionName
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Name of the subscription to use

properties.name: subscriptionTopicsMode
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Determines to which topics this consumer should be subscribed to - Persistent, Non-Persistent, or both. Only used with pattern subscriptions.

properties.name: subscriptionType
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Type of the subscription EXCLUSIVESHAREDFAILOVERKEY_SHARED, defaults to EXCLUSIVE

properties.name: topicsPattern
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Whether the topic is a pattern (regular expression) that allows the consumer to subscribe to all matching topics in the namespace

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: batcherBuilder
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Control batching method used by the producer.

properties.name: batchingEnabled
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Control whether automatic batching of messages is enabled for the producer.

properties.name: batchingMaxMessages
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The maximum size to batch messages.

properties.name: batchingMaxPublishDelayMicros
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The maximum time period within which the messages sent will be batched if batchingEnabled is true.

properties.name: blockIfQueueFull
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Whether to block the producing thread if pending messages queue is full or to throw a ProducerQueueIsFullError

properties.name: chunkingEnabled
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Control whether chunking of messages is enabled for the producer.

properties.name: compressionType
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Compression type to use

properties.name: hashingScheme
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Hashing function to use when choosing the partition to use for a particular message

properties.name: initialSequenceId
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The first message published will have a sequence Id of initialSequenceId 1.

properties.name: maxPendingMessages
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Size of the pending massages queue. When the queue is full, by default, any further sends will fail unless blockIfQueueFull=true

properties.name: maxPendingMessagesAcrossPartitions
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The maximum number of pending messages for partitioned topics. The maxPendingMessages value will be reduced if (number of partitions maxPendingMessages) exceeds this value. Partitioned topics have a pending message queue for each partition.

properties.name: messageRouter
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Custom Message Router to use

properties.name: messageRoutingMode
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Message Routing Mode to use

properties.name: producerName
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Name of the producer. If unset, lets Pulsar select a unique identifier.

properties.name: sendTimeoutMs
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Send timeout in milliseconds

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
